title: Buga Sphere symbols recognised by Mario Woods and Randy Anderson
place_text: Buga, Colombia; Ellsworth Air Force Base

tellings.quote: is I showed photos of the symbols to Mario Woods and to Randy Anderson. Mario Woods, 1977 Ellsworth Air Force Base experiencer.

plain: Michels says he showed photos of the symbols on the Buga sphere, an object reported from Buga, Colombia, to two men who each say they had their own encounters, and the story goes that both recognised them. One was Mario Woods, whom Michels calls a 1977 experiencer at Ellsworth Air Force Base, meaning a man who says something strange happened to him there. The other was Randy Anderson, a man who says he saw alien technology on a military base. If true, the markings would link the Colombian object to older American accounts.
